text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. Indeed, my injury does throb a 
little~
choice_data_list:
That doesn't feel like 'just a little' at 
all!

That really doesn't seem like 'just a 
little'!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it is merely a scratch. An injury 
of this degree is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
For I am an umamusume of the Mejiro 
family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"If I falter and stop over something like 
this, how could I ever fulfill my great 
ambition~?"
choice_data_list: I can't overlook that as a Trainer

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...I have watched you all. Steadfastly 
pressing forward at all times, never 
faltering."
choice_data_list:
Let's rest for now so you can keep moving 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, indeed. It seems I was lacking a bit 
of composure.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Pardon my disgraceful display. I shall 
surely make up for this dishonor with my 
running~.

In return, I made sure she understood that 
if anything felt even slightly off, we 
would stop immediately.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Well then, right 
away—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Why is this happening...? My body... won't 
move forward...?

Her body had reached its limit far more 
than Mejiro Bright had realized. I 
hurriedly made her take a rest...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"If I cannot move, then I shall gain 
knowledge to apply to our next training 
session..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
For a while, I shall continue to strive 
forward like this while letting my body 
rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Never staying down after a fall is one of 
the strengths of a Mejiro Umamusume, after 
all~.
